task_description: Complete visual redesign of the Madarek platform. Ground-up rebuild of the design system: new color system (Navy Royal Blue + Muted Gold), new token system, new dark theme with warm grays, redesigned landing page, refined dashboard/internal pages, performance-optimized CSS architecture, and full RTL/responsive/accessibility compliance.

Review issues fixed: utility classes restored, shadow-xl distinct, card tokens added, table zebra-striping added. V2 review fixes: 107 domain component classes added (annotations, search, feed, leaderboard, curriculum, badges, risk, permissions, track, compact-kpi, exam-bar, auth), .empty-state/.text-md/.spin classes added, table even-row hover fixed to surface-3, typography scale comment added.
